# Mohammed Ahmed Hussain

> Sales Manager | AI & SaaS Solutions
> Hyderabad, Telangana, India

Mohammed Ahmed Hussain (also known as Ahmed Hussain) is a sales and operations professional with 6+ years across technology sales, AI/SaaS product sales, technical staffing, client relationships, and team coordination.

He manages sales conversations from prospecting and discovery through product demos, onboarding, and ongoing customer support, with practical knowledge of AI voice solutions, CRM and outreach tools, and workflow automation.

## Positioning

- Sales Manager / Product Sales Manager
- AI & SaaS Solutions
- B2B sales & full sales-cycle management
- Customer onboarding & retention
- AI voice agents / telephony
- Cross-functional sales and operations

Not a software engineer or AI engineer. Sales + operations operator who partners with leadership, customers, sales, and product/technical teams.
